Job Type: Internship

Description:

About NITES

Nippon IT and Educational Solution (NITES) is a global technology hub dedicated to bridging the technical excellence of Japan with the innovative spirit of Sri Lanka. We specialize in high-impact software solutions, offshore development, and bridging the gap between education and professional mastery. Join our Creative Crew in Galle and work on projects that span borders.

Role Description -We are looking for a highly motivated Full-Stack Software Engineer Intern who lives and breathes code. You will work alongside senior architects to build scalable, cloud-native applications using modern tech stacks. This is a Paid Internship designed to fast-track your career into a Junior Developer role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate on the design and development of robust backend services using Python, Java (Spring Boot), or PHP (Laravel).
  • Build responsive, high-performance frontends using React.js and modern UI frameworks.
  • Implement microservices architectures and integrate third-party APIs (Payments, Email, Storage).
  • Participate in code reviews and agile sprints to ensure high-quality delivery.

  •  No Prior Experience Required: We do not require years of experience or specific language expertise at the intern level.
  • Academic Level: 3rd or 4th-year university students or candidates with a minimum HND/Higher Diploma
  • Technical Base: Solid understanding of OOP, Data Structures, and RESTful APIs.
  • DevOps Exposure: Basic understanding or strong interest in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and CI/CD .
  • Passion: A proven portfolio of personal or academic projects.
  • Communication: Strong problem-solving skills and a collaborative mindset.
  • The NITES Edge: Proficiency in Japanese (JLPT N5 or above) is a significant advantage

Why join NITES ?

  • Paid Internship: Receive a competitive monthly stipend for your contributions
  • Health Insurance: We prioritize the well-being of our team members from day one.
  • Flexibility: Work Onsite in our Galle hub, or enjoy Hybrid/Remote options.

How to apply?

Ready to start your professional journey?

  • Follow NITES on LinkedIn.

Please send your CV and portfolio to:  nipponsolutions.nites@gmail.com

item.title: Senior Software Engineer â€“ Fullstack (Java) at HealthRecon Connect LLC
item.content:encoded:
Company: HealthRecon Connect LLC
Location: Colombo
Job Type: Full-time

Description:

HealthRecon Connect provides technology-enabled Revenue Cycle Management solutions to US healthcare providers. The company leverages over 30 years of deep domain expertise, machine learning, AI, cutting-edge analytics, and automated workflows that help improve cash flow, patient outcomes and enable peace of mind for their clients. At HealthRecon Connect, day after day, we not only hold ourselves accountable for setting and maintaining high standards, but we also passionately strive for the highest achievement, customer delight and thrive on the challenge of high expectations and commitment to excel.

HealthRecon was certified a Great Workplace by Great Place to Work® Sri Lanka since 2018 and was adjudged one of the 40 Best Workplaces in Sri Lanka by Great Place to Work® Sri Lanka in 2021. We are also a participant of the United Nations Global Compact.

HRC Labs was established to lead the technological transformation of HealthRecon Connect (HRC). Propelled by the deep domain expertise and industry leading service capability of HRC, HRC Labs focus on enhancing the efficiency of healthcare delivery through intelligent automation solutions for healthcare providers. Our tools sustainably improve clients’ operating margins and cash flows by compressing their working capital cycle and reducing their administrative burden.

The Senior Software Engineer – Fullstack (Java) will design, develop, test, and maintain responsive front-end interfaces and secure back-end solutions. The role includes integrating RESTful APIs and microservices, optimizing databases, troubleshooting issues, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable full-stack applications supporting healthcare Revenue Cycle Management technology automation.

Due to the large volume of applications we receive, all applications will be reviewed in the order in which they were received and only the candidates short-listed for the first round of interviews will be contacted. Thank you for your understanding.

Job Vacancy:
Senior Software Engineer – Fullstack (Java)

Work Week:
Monday to Friday

Shift Window:
03:00 PM – 12:00 AM IST (Straddle Shift)

Important: HealthRecon Connect currently operates under a hybrid work arrangement, with the number of remote workdays varying by team. However, depending on client deliverables and business needs, employees may be required to work on-site for all five weekdays.

By applying, you acknowledge and agree to be available for in-person work five days a week if required.

Other Features:

Full-time
US calendar applicable

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers to translate requirements into technical specifications and user stories.
  • Design, develop, and maintain responsive user interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and frameworks such as React.js, Angular, or Vue.js.
  • Build scalable and secure back-end solutions using Java and other server-side technologies.
  • Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and microservices for front-end and back-end systems.
  • Design and optimize database schemas, SQL queries, and relational or NoSQL database operations.
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-documented code in line with coding standards and best practices.
  • Conduct unit, integration, and end-to-end testing; troubleshoot, debug, and resolve issues.
  • Keep up with full-stack development trends and collaborate effectively across teams, supporting knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Qualifications/Criteria:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field; relevant technical certifications are an advantage.
  • At least 4 years of software development experience, with a track record of delivering full-stack solutions for complex applications.
  • Proficiency in front-end and back-end development, including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript frameworks, and server-side technologies such as Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, Django, or Ruby on Rails.
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, design patterns, and software development concepts.
  • Knowledge of RESTful web services, microservices architecture, and API design principles.
  • Solid understanding of relational databases, SQL, and ORM frameworks; familiarity with NoSQL databases, caching, and message brokers is a plus.
  • Experience with Git and code collaboration platforms such as GitHub or GitLab.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills, with effective communication and teamwork abilities; ability to mentor junior colleagues and adapt to new technologies.


Apply for this job

item.content:encoded:

Description:

Industry
Enterprise Software / SaaS / AI

Work Location 
Negombo, Sri Lanka (On-site)

About Enhanzer

Enhanzer is building the next generation of AI-powered enterprise software platforms. We believe great companies are built by great people, strong brands, continuous innovation, and exceptional customer experiences.

We’re looking for a passionate, curious, and proactive Full Stack Developer –Associate to become a member of our Engineering team.

This is more than a traditional development role. You’ll work closely with developers, product teams, and management to build and enhance software products, solve technical challenges, and contribute to delivering high-quality solutions for local and international customers.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack applications using Angular and C# .NET Core.
  • Build responsive, user-friendly interfaces using Angular, HTML, CSS, and TypeScript.
  • Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and third-party system integrations.
  • Design and optimize SQL Server databases, queries, and stored procedures.
  • Translate functional requirements into reliable technical solutions.
  • Prepare test cases and test scenarios for developed features.
  • Perform thorough developer testing, including functional, validation, negative, and regression testing.
  • Write and maintain unit tests and integration tests to ensure application reliability.
  • Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve issues across frontend, backend, API, and database layers.
  • Write clean, scalable, secure, and maintainable code following development standards.
  • Participate in code reviews and continuously improve development and testing practices.

Your Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with QA, product, and other teams to deliver quality features on time.
  • Use AI-assisted development and testing tools effectively to improve productivity and code quality.
  • Take ownership of assigned tasks from development through testing, bug fixing, and delivery.

What We’re Looking For

  • Graduates or undergraduates in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline, with a professional qualification in Information Technology.
  • At least 6 months of internship experience in a related role.
  • Hands-on experience in Full Stack Development using the Angular and C#.NET Core tech stack, with a solid foundation in HTML/CSS principles and a proven ability to develop userfriendly web applications.
  • Proficient in designing and integrating RESTful APIs and working with SQL Server databases to build robust backend systems.
  • Experience with Microservices architecture and GraphQL is an
    added advantage.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for effectively addressing technical challenges.
  • High attention to detail, with a strong motivation to learn and adapt to new technologies, features, and updates.
  • Ability to work effectively under minimal supervision, demonstrating initiative and self-direction.
  • Capacity to build and maintain positive relationships, foster cooperation, and provide support to colleagues and stakeholders.

Added Advantages

  • Knowledge of programming languages such as Python.
  • Understanding of OOP and software development principles.
  • Familiarity with Git and version control systems.
  • Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Experience with academic, personal, or open-source software projects.

What You’ll Gain

  • Practical experience in software development and engineering.
  • Exposure to SaaS, enterprise software, cloud, and AI products.
  • Hands-on experience in application development, APIs, databases, and debugging.
  • Experience working with modern development tools, frameworks, and technologies.
  • Opportunity to work closely with developers, QA engineers, product teams, and management.
  • Career growth based on performance and continuous learning. 

Career Path

  • Full Stack Developer– Trainee
  • → Full Stack Developer
  • → Senior Full Stack Developer
  • → Tech Lead / Full Stack Architect

Join us in building the future of AI-powered enterprise software.

If you’re passionate about software development, problem-solving, and building innovative technology solutions, we’d love to hear from you.
